notes.title: Update 1.1.2 Notes
notes.notes:
Game Optimization
- Improved DLSS and FSR logic for overall performance enhancement

Quality Improvements and Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where movement speed occasionally increased after a kick
- Fixed unnatural movement transitions when using keyboard while aiming with a pistol

We will continue to improve the gameplay experience.
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes: Overhauled lighting and shadow structure for game optimization.

notes.title: Update 1.0.15
notes.notes:
- Adjusted initial mouse and gamepad camera sensitivity
- Fixed an issue where a specific NPC was difficult to find in the first area
- Fixed an issue where players could be hit and trapped by the Muscle Ghost in a specific spot in the first area
- Fixed an issue where characters would intermittently keep walking during conversations

notes.title: 1.0.13 Update
notes.notes:
Graphics Environment Option Added
- Lowering the environment setting from “Normal” to “Low” increases the game’s frame rate.

Frame Limit Option Added
- Limiting the frame rate allows for a quieter and more stable gameplay experience.

Sexual Content (Low) Option Added
- Changes the clothing of the player and enemies.
- Underwear exposure is disabled.
- Wet clothing transparency effect is disabled.

Sexual Content (Normal) is still available without changes.

notes.title: 1.0.9 Update
notes.notes:
Camera Logic Improvements
- Tuned the camera to maintain stability throughout gameplay
- Fixed a screen shaking issue when ghosts, humans, or tentacles appear close to the camera

notes.title: 1.0.8 Update
notes.notes:
Controls Improvement
- Fixed the issue where you had to re-press movement keys after guarding or shooting
- You can now move while reloading
- Reduced stamina consumption when starting to sprint for the first time
- Fixed an intermittent issue where the character would freeze while moving

notes.title: 1.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where, in some language regions, the game would not progress after all ghosts were hunted during the tutorial.

notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
Text typo corrections

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where, in some language regions, the game would not progress after the man in the blue shirt disappeared during the tutorial.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Difficulty Adjustment
